features.title: Everything production needs
features.subtitle: Professional tools that replace hours of manual work — built by a filmmaker with 15+ years in film and media.
features.script_breakdown_desc: Upload any screenplay and instantly generate cast, props, costume, location, equipment breakdowns — scene by scene. Includes scene number, INT/EXT and DAY/NIGHT for every scene.
features.shooting_schedule_desc: Generate complete production schedules from your script breakdown. Scenes organised by location, cast requirements and shoot days.
features.call_sheet_desc: Generate professional call sheets from your breakdown and schedule data. Cast, crew, locations and timing — formatted and ready to share.
features.production_budget_desc: Estimate production budgets from your script breakdown data. Cost projections for cast, locations, equipment and crew.
features.crew_management_desc: A complete production workflow system for managing crew, departments and production tracking.
features.language_support_desc: Full support for English, Yorùbá, French, Spanish and 9 more languages. Auto-detects script language.
